contract.purpose: Create a structured decision-support layer from validated evidence, wisdom engines, reasoning, and critique outputs.

decision_options.name: Proceed to further evidence investigation
decision_options.description: Collect additional evidence to address unresolved uncertainties and knowledge gaps before a scientific decision.

decision_options.name: Proceed to focused hypothesis evaluation
decision_options.description: Evaluate a defined scientific hypothesis using additional targeted evidence and appropriate validation.

decision_options.name: Hold pending contradiction or evidence resolution
decision_options.description: Pause decision progression when evidence conflicts, uncertainty, or missing information requires resolution.

decision_options.name: Escalate for expert scientific review
decision_options.description: Route the decision context to a qualified human reviewer when evidence or consequences require expert assessment.

decision_criteria.name: Evidence Support
decision_criteria.description: Are claims traceable to available evidence?

decision_criteria.name: Evidence Quality
decision_criteria.description: Is the supporting evidence sufficiently characterized?

decision_criteria.name: Mechanistic Relevance
decision_criteria.description: Is mechanistic relevance supported by the evidence?

decision_criteria.name: Therapeutic Relevance
decision_criteria.description: Is therapeutic relevance supported by available evidence?

decision_criteria.name: Clinical Relevance
decision_criteria.description: Are clinical and development considerations represented?

decision_criteria.name: Knowledge Gaps
decision_criteria.description: Are unresolved knowledge gaps explicitly preserved?

decision_criteria.name: Contradictions
decision_criteria.description: Are detected or unresolved contradictions represented?

decision_criteria.name: Traceability
decision_criteria.description: Can decision-support elements be traced to source artifacts?

evidence_trace.agent_source_links_note: No agent-to-source links were available in the validated knowledge graph. This limitation is preserved and not fabricated.

uncertainty_register.source: validated upstream evidence and reasoning artifacts

knowledge_gap_register.source: validated upstream evidence and reasoning artifacts

limitations: Decision intelligence is decision support, not autonomous decision making.
Agent-to-source links are not available and are not fabricated.
Baseline wisdom-engine outputs are structural decision-support inputs.
No option is automatically selected as the scientific decision.
